北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感 -7℃，风力 3级，保暖防风是关键哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels like -7℃ with a Level 3 wind, keep warm and protect from wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行注意安全，开车减速慢行。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, travel safely and drive slowly.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海朋友，大雾天气，视线不佳，注意交通安全。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai friends, dense fog means low visibility, please mind traffic safety.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，但湿度高，记得多喝水保持舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and humid, remember to hydrate and stay comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，18℃ 暖暖的，尽情享受好天气吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is warm and sunny at 18℃, enjoy the lovely weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道健康。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze, wear a mask when going out to protect your respiratory health.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，气温 11℃ 稍凉，出门加件外套哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but cool at 11℃, remember to wear an extra layer.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都虽然晴朗，但 6℃ 仍凉，湿度大，注意保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny but cold at 6℃, high humidity, stay warm.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，出门佩戴口罩，减少户外逗留时间。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, wear a mask and limit outdoor time.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，体感 3℃，记得多喝水、做好保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry, feels like 3℃, hydrate and moisturize.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾且湿度高，戴口罩，多补充水分吧。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze and high humidity, wear a mask and drink more water.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -24℃ 极寒，务必全副武装，注意防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -24℃, extremely cold, bundle up to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -22℃，寒意十足，多穿衣物抵御严寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -22℃, very cold, wear plenty of layers to brave the chill.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，9℃ 虽凉，户外活动也别忘了添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, 9℃ is cool, add layers for outdoor activities.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 17℃，阳光明媚，微风和煦，适合出游哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 17℃, sunny with a gentle breeze, perfect for outings.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 5级，体感 -8℃，注意防风保暖，小心感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has Level 5 wind, feels like -8℃, stay warm and prevent colds.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -14℃，风力 4级，多穿厚衣，戴好围巾帽子。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -14℃ with Level 4 wind, wear thick clothes, scarves, and hats.
